topic: comparing what daily life actually looks like at five wealth levels: broke (net worth zero or negative), one thousand dollars saved, one million dollars, one billion dollars, and one trillion dollars -- make the scale differences viscerally concrete, not abstract
title: What a Trillion Dollars Actually Looks Like
description:
We throw around words like million, billion, and trillion. But the difference in scale between them is so vast it breaks our brains. Here's what those levels of wealth actually mean for a daily life.
